## Spec

ClientGroupSpec defines which clients belong to the group.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.clients` | `[]object` | Items: at most 1000 |
| `spec.clients[].cidr` | `string` |  |
| `spec.clients[].clientID` | `string` | ClientID matches DoT SNI / DoH path client identifiers (v0.2). |
| `spec.clients[].comment` | `string` |  |
| `spec.clients[].hostname` | `string` |  |
| `spec.clients[].ip` | `string` |  |
| `spec.clients[].mac` | `string` | MAC matches through an inventory source such as UniFi (v0.2). |
| `spec.clients[].name` | `string` |  |
| `spec.clients[].nameGlob` | `string` |  |
| `spec.sources` | `object` | ClientGroupSources lets an integration add members (v0.2). |
| `spec.sources.integrationRef` | `object` | ObjectRef points at another kudurru object. Namespace is omitted for cluster-scoped kinds and for same-namespace references. |
| `spec.sources.integrationRef.name` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: at least 1 |
| `spec.sources.integrationRef.namespace` | `string` |  |

## Status

ClientGroupStatus is the observed state of a client group.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |
| `status.members` | `integer` |  |
| `status.observedGeneration` | `integer` | Format: `int64` |

## Example

`deploy/kustomize/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_clientgroup.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: ClientGroup
metadata:
  name: kids
  namespace: dns
spec:
  clients:
    - cidr: 10.0.20.0/24
      name: Kids VLAN
    - hostname: "ps5*"
```
